The note ties "seeth all things rightly" (133:2) to the shielding by the fear of Elohim at 133:4; both are live in the same address.
"enlightening the Gentiles" is at 141:2 and the note joins it to the synagogues of 141:3; both live in the adjacent pair.

new_note: Deut 30:4 — *from thence will Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee.* — the gathering of "all Yashar'el (Israel) shall be gathered unto Yahuah (Lord)" Benjamin foresees.
reason: Live reads "all Yashar'el (Israel) shall be gathered unto Yahuah (Lord)".
